name: Live Translator
description: Mac menu bar app that shows live translated subtitles for any system audio, translating on-device with TranslateGemma through MLX and optionally reading them aloud.
compatibility: Runs TranslateGemma 4B (4-bit or 8-bit, chosen by memory) or an opt-in 12B 4-bit model through mlx-lm; models download from Hugging Face on first use.
Captures system audio with ScreenCaptureKit and transcribes it with Apple speech recognition; speech output uses the built-in macOS voices or Piper.
OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic providers are optional and need the user's own API key.
limitations: The free on-device mode needs Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or newer; Intel Macs need a cloud API key.
Apple speech recognition runs on-device only for languages whose dictation model is installed; other languages use Apple's servers.
The first run downloads 2.2 to 6.7 GB of model weights, which follow the Gemma Terms of Use.
Needs the Screen and System Audio Recording permission.

sources.note: On-device model tiers and download sizes, Apple Silicon and macOS 14 requirement, speech recognition privacy behaviour, permissions, optional cloud providers and voices.
Model tiers, Hugging Face repositories and the memory-based default choice.
